Section: ObjectShard Lab owner evaluation > Controls
Choose a scenario, then **Resume**, **Pause**, **Single step**, or **Reset**. The default view uses native material colours. Left-drag with **Erase**, **Wood**, **Sand**, **Water**, or **Ignite**. Right-click, or select **Inspect**, to inspect the exact owner, local identity, state and temperature of a material cell. **Erase lower Wood band** finds the lowest current Wood row and removes the lowest twelve rows through the same ordinary native edit operation used by the brush. It is a convenience for making a readable fall; there is no special cut-to-physics command or fixed component capture rectangle. The optional **Shapes / centre of mass / pocket** overlay shows exact collision rectangles in cyan, centre of mass in gold and the admitted pocket in green. Empty holes remain empty. The side panel records structural inventory, products, cargo, revisions, native events and measured frame/promotion costs. The ownership and inspection panes scroll when their diagnostics exceed the available window height. **Erase** resolves the actual material owner. Stationary material is edited in World; moving structural material is erased through an identity-fenced native shard transaction, followed by collision installation and acknowledgement between Rapier steps. Other moving material replacement and cargo painting are refused. Ignition and inspection remain owner-aware. Fast drags use a continuous four-connected cut rather than disconnected mouse samples. At most 256 unique cells wait in the edit queue and at most 16 execute per frame. The pending count is visible, and pause/export remain available. A target that changes owner while waiting is refused explicitly. Let the pending count reach zero before assessing a cut or resuming a paused multi-cut experiment. **Erode resting cell** selects an actually sleeping body, then queues one visible structural-cell erasure. It does not apply a scripted impulse or freeze the body. **External Fire burner** authors genuine Fire into Empty World cells at the outlined fixed source positions. It never deletes Wood, overwrites cargo or draws decorative flames. Its authored Fire count is separate from products generated by native chemistry.

Section: ObjectShard Lab owner evaluation > Scenario B — burning Wood tree
The tree is genuinely Wood, with an existing native burn countdown. Resume for a few ticks, then remove support. Inspect a burning cell before and after promotion. Its burn state must continue rather than restart. Allow several seconds for Wood consumption to change the structure and collision geometry. Ordinary Wood combustion is unchanged. One or two initially burning pixels may die out without consuming the whole tree. For sustained erosion, use **J — Sustained external flame** or enable the visible burner and place the reacting structure in its path. Fire remains an external material source; native selected contact and combustion decisions determine whether a Wood cell ignites. **PASS:** native combustion continues after motion begins and while the body sleeps. Wood produces actual Fire; delivered Fire enters World and follows the native Fire-to-Smoke lifecycle. The side panel's product/output accounting must advance. Bright cells are drawn from native material state, not decorative flames. This first slice keeps disconnected structural islands in one compound. The panel labels this **split_pending**. Independent fragment motion is not claimed. Persistent, conspicuously floating branches should be reported as a gameplay limitation; small transient disconnected regions are expected before fracture.

Section: OBJECTSHARD-001 — compact moving material domains > M1 executable checkpoint
The registry scheduler now invokes the shared Wood/Fire/Smoke lifecycle decisions on the native semantic clock. It processes only due carriers, starts strictly after capture/birth, retains the original logical coordinate anchor through movement and does not depend on Rapier sleeping. Dormant Wood retains a deadline and is explicitly awakened by admitted ignition. The canonical `MaterialRules::pair_reaction` resolver is reused; none of the admitted local material pairs is a consuming pair, and newly introduced unsupported pairs fail closed instead of silently acquiring cross-domain authority. Products occupy actual local carriers. Wood emits Fire32 into an Empty neighbour; blocked Fire can transition to Smoke under shard ownership. Smoke has its own lifetime/crowding lane; no local gas transport is claimed. The same occupied product cannot also be duplicated in an outbox. Erosion changes exact occupied geometry and mass; disconnected islands remain an explicit `split_pending` compound while chemistry continues. Losing the final skeleton retains a draining product domain independently of body retirement. Native M1 qualification: **59,281 checks, zero failures** (storage8,125, contact44,727, coordinator1,957, original World oracle4,472). The frozen native input digest is `b3ad04377b1cca02bf1711fba33504546dc9c7bf2b00b9369fedfaa738bc4782`. It covers pre-transfer World burn, sleeping/moving logical-anchor continuity, retained Fire32→Smoke, final-skeleton draining and burning perforation beyond eight exact shapes. Native ACK fixtures do not substitute for Rapier tests. Actual Godot4.7.2 M1 iteration passed154 checks: Rapier was observed sleeping while the same Wood countdown progressed237→227 over20semantic ticks; three real retained Fire products were born, retained Fire→Smoke was observed and an81-shape perforated body activated. The iteration extension SHA256 is `4e3e18891d2b2f9c3d97e150bebc28778b13084dde3babfcc79fcad21f1137b5`. The initial enclosed-ignition fixture's two failures are retained; moving ignition to the genuine exposed crown edge repaired the fixture without changing chemistry. M1 output remains disabled: World Fire/Smoke created before transfer is not evidence of shard emission. These checkpoints are intentionally distinct from the later M2 candidate, whose outgoing/incoming transfers and Windows package require fresh execution.

Section: ObjectShard Lab owner evaluation > Scenario C — external contact and lodging
Detach the pocket structure. The authored Sand is above an open channel; more Sand can be placed over it. The capture must occur through the physical aperture, not through a solid wall. Inspect carried Sand to see its material, state, temperature and cargo identity. Ignite Wood, then place Water against an exposed burning surface. Water remains owned by World while the accepted contact extinguishes that Wood incarnation. Pause, inspect and single-step to see the change. Contact and ingestion are separate capabilities; Water is not silently copied into a private liquid solver. The admitted opening is one to three cells wide. A suspicious sideways entry holds ingestion until that local opening is clear again; it must not become a valid capture merely because the body subsequently stops moving. Most Sand can legitimately miss or pass through the small capture aperture and reach the floor. Inspect the lodged cell and cargo count to distinguish real ingestion from bypass. This experiment does not advertise an internal granular solver or an unlimited Sand container. **PASS:** real Sand is removed from World exactly once and becomes inspectable cargo; genuine Water contact changes burning Wood; failed delivery retains its inventory and reports a blocked state. A vanished pocket or retired rigid body must not silently delete remaining cargo or products.

Section: OBJECTSHARD-001 — compact moving material domains > M2 ownership and exchange
The M2 coordinator owns World and all registry inventories under one exclusive Lab owner. The public bridge copies observations and explicit receipts; it never exposes mutable cell storage. The ordinary Workbench worker and immutable Workbench compound adapter are unchanged. The new revisioned adapter replaces complete exact geometry between manual Rapier steps, binds material/geometry revision, generation, mass, COM and inertia, and acknowledges actual installation. One native owner identity is independent of the number of compound rectangles. Every conservative exchange validates a monotonic transaction, session, shard generation, cell incarnation, body generation, applied geometry, pose serial, capability version and exact accepted tuple. It reserves local/World capacity before debiting inventory. A bounded receipt ring returns prior outcomes, while the retired sequence watermark prevents evicted transactions from executing again. Unexpected partial progress retains the actual sole owner in quarantine; expected stale, capacity, unsupported and destination refusals are nonmutating. **Authentic output:** Wood creates Fire32 in a real local product carrier. The outbox is a proposal referencing that carrier, not another material copy. At an admitted transformed destination the coordinator transfers the exact Fire tuple into a resident Empty World cell. World then executes its ordinary Fire→Smoke lifecycle and world-up movement. Blocked products remain occupied and execute only their supported retained lifecycle; no failed delivery deletes inventory. The declaration does not promise internal gas transport. **Physical Sand ingress:** baseline whole-cell Sand may lodge through an open one-to-three-cell-wide pocket. Structural side walls, the full supporting floor and a clear column to the local top define the aperture. Current pose and the bounded actual pose sweep must admit entry through that aperture. State and temperature transfer once; carried Sand is inspectable and visible, contributes declared unit-cell mass and occupancy, and does not create a structural bond. The Lab's C fixture uses a three-cell opening so ordinary small rigid-body rotation does not make the demonstration depend on perfect lattice alignment. Invalid side-entry history is retained until the complete aperture column is observably clear. History sampling runs before any cargo mutation and even when the transfer budget is zero or exhausted. Mechanical overlap relocation excludes all pocket capture columns, including temporarily occupied ones; it cannot manufacture a later valid-looking ingress by moving Sand through a solid wall. This is distinct from ordinary World material movement through a real opening. **External Water exposure:** before overlap relocation, a bounded pose sweep captures actual World-owned Water adjacent to a shard Wood cell. Section: ObjectShard Lab owner evaluation > Deliberate limits
M0–M2 supports admitted structural cells, selected shared combustion/product lifecycle, real bounded output, whole-cell baseline Sand lodging and selected non-consuming Water contact. It does not provide general fracture, internal gas or liquid transport, fractional liquid ingestion, solver-sidecar transfer, durable save/restore or streaming. The motion envelope retains four cells of translation and 0.20 radians of rotation per accepted physical segment. Section: ObjectShard Lab owner evaluation > Scenario C — external contact and lodging
Detach the pocket structure. The authored Sand is above an open channel; more Sand can be placed over it. The capture must occur through the physical aperture, not through a solid wall. Inspect carried Sand to see its material, state, temperature and cargo identity. Ignite Wood, then place Water against an exposed burning surface. Water remains owned by World while the accepted contact extinguishes that Wood incarnation. Pause, inspect and single-step to see the change. Contact and ingestion are separate capabilities; Water is not silently copied into a private liquid solver. The admitted opening is one to three cells wide. A suspicious sideways entry holds ingestion until that local opening is clear again; it must not become a valid capture merely because the body subsequently stops moving. Most Sand can legitimately miss or pass through the small capture aperture and reach the floor. Inspect the lodged cell and cargo count to distinguish real ingestion from bypass. This experiment does not advertise an internal granular solver or an unlimited Sand container. **PASS:** real Sand is removed from World exactly once and becomes inspectable cargo; genuine Water contact changes burning Wood; failed delivery retains its inventory and reports a blocked state. A vanished pocket or retired rigid body must not silently delete remaining cargo or products.

Full rebuilt ELF floor verification and fresh Linux/Windows execution passed in the final campaign recorded below. Visual review of the first Windows PNGs confirmed actual rotated shapes, burning material/products, consumed holes, carried Sand and retained draining products. It also found stale scenario-selection and inspection presentation. The repaired scene keeps the dropdown and overlay state synchronized, clears obsolete inspection on reset, and places material/owner/state/temperature before the exact JSON. The capture now inspects the extinguished Wood instead of stale Sand. Added actual-scene assertions raise the integrated inventory to379 checks; the rebuilt final runtime executed all of them on Linux and Windows.
